steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: CAPM requires a secondary degree and completion of project management education hours—no prior work experience necessary. This makes CAPM ideal for career changers and early-career professionals entering Sioux Falls's growing healthcare, financial services, and manufacturing sectors. Verify your qualifications before enrolling.

steps_items.heading: Complete 23 Hours of Education
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led boot camp. This intensive format compresses project management fundamentals into a focused schedule, allowing you to earn your required contact hours while balancing work and life in Sioux Falls. Classes are taught by active certified practitioners.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing your education hours, submit your CAPM application directly to PMI and pay the exam fee. Granite PM Academy will guide you through the application process to ensure accuracy and timely submission so you can proceed to exam preparation.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources to review PMBOK® Guide concepts, practice questions, and test-taking strategies. On exam day, you'll demonstrate mastery of project management processes and terminology. Our instructors provide ongoing support through your final review.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your CAPM Credential
steps_items.text: CAPM credentials are valid for three years. During this cycle, earn professional development units through PMI-recognized training, volunteer work, or mentoring. Renew on schedule to keep your credential active and competitive in Sioux Falls's job market.

fq_items.question: Do I need project management experience to take the CAPM?
fq_items.answer: No prior PM experience is required. The CAPM only requires secondary education (high school diploma or equivalent) and 23 contact hours of project management education — which our course fulfills.

fq_items.question: Is the CAPM a good starting credential for {city} professionals?
fq_items.answer: Yes. The CAPM is one of the most recognized entry-level PM credentials and is highly regarded across industries in {city_state}. It demonstrates PM knowledge to employers even before you have years of experience.

fq_items.question: How does the CAPM differ from the PMP?
fq_items.answer: The PMP requires 36–60 months of project leadership experience; the CAPM does not. Many professionals earn the CAPM early in their career, gain experience, then pursue the PMP.

fq_items.question: Is this training delivered online?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Our CAPM training is fully live-virtual — no travel required. {city} students attend via video conference from wherever they are.
